feat(allowance): operator-configured spend allowance ledger
In exfer-stack/exfer-walletd, his own repository.
This pull request is merged.
https://github.com/exfer-stack/exfer-walletd/pull/3

Adds per-transaction and per-period (rolling-window) native-EXFER spend ceilings to walletd, enforced on `transfer` + `htlc_lock`. Caps are **config only** (`--spend-cap-*`), immutable over the RPC, and **default to unlimited** — existing deployments and every downstream client (mobile/desktop/mcp/py/honor) are unaffected at runtime.

## What
- `src/allowance.rs`: redb-backed ledger. Atomic check-and-reserve in a single write txn (no lost-update under concurrent spends); refund on broadcast failure so a failed tx doesn't burn the window.
- Enforcement reserves **inside** the idempotency unit (no double-charge / no false-reject on retry); stateless per-tx fast-fail before keystore I/O.
- `swap_get_quote` fails closed on `exfer_to_bnb` while caps are active (the daemon-signed EXFER swap leg isn't metered yet — v1 follow-up).
- New error `AllowanceExceeded` (-32038, structured data); unknown code degrades to base `WalletdError` in all clients.
- New read-only `allowance_status` RPC; startup log when caps are active.

## Review
3-agent peer review found 1 BLOCKER (swap EXFER drain) + 2 MAJOR (concurrency lost-update; idempotent-retry false-reject) — all fixed. Confirmatory re-review: **mergeable, no new defects**.

## Tests
302 pass, incl. concurrency regression (no overshoot / no lost update) + swap gate. `clippy --all-targets` clean, `fmt` clean.

## Known v1 limitations / follow-ups
- Swap EXFER leg metered via fail-closed, not yet a real cap (tracked).
- `exfer-walletd-mobile` / `-desktop` use exhaustive `Config{}` literals — add 3 fields when they bump the walletd pin (compile-time only).
- `exfer-mcp` README:5/264 + `__init__.py:17` reference a stale "v1.10 allowance ledger" promise — to be corrected.
